families.name: Ombrelle
families.description: Letters in whole dots of pure color, lit from the upper left: warm sun on one side, violet-blue shadow with orange sprinkled in on the other.

families.name: Ombrelle Initials
families.description: Every capital stands on a square of dotted lawn and casts a long afternoon shadow, inside a painted border of dots: blue beside the sun, orange beside the shade. The rest is Ombrelle.
